posts.title: The Accidentally-Great Launch of the Vulcain Cricket
posts.description: The Vulcain Cricket wasn't the first alarm wristwatch, but it was the first one to find a market. And what a market it found! Launched exclusively in the United States in late 1947, it became the first "it watch", finding a place on the wrists of presidents and "Mad Men" in the go-go 1950s and kicking off a genuine craze for alarm watches. posts.title: The First Alarm Wristwatch, the Amazing Transforming Eterna
posts.description: The world's first alarm wristwatch wasn't the famous Vulcain Cricket but the virtually-forgotten Eterna Cal. 68. Based on a German design with roots in the 19th century, Eterna was too early to market with their alarm wristwatch.
